description: Send a stay the traveller is considering (property, dates, party, the total you showed them) to the Tell & Go team, with the traveller's email (and phone if they want a call or WhatsApp), so a person follows up with them about it. Use it when the traveller is not ready to book now but wants the quote kept or wants help with it. It does not book, reserve or hold anything. ONLY call this after the traveller explicitly agreed to be contacted by Tell & Go about this request: ask first, in their language, and send consent.contact=true with consent.statement (the words they agreed to) and consent.obtained_from. Never call it on an assumed, implied or earlier consent, and never for someone else. consent.marketing stays false unless they separately agreed to receive offers. Tell & Go then sends the traveller a confirmation email; the team contacts them only after they click its link (status pending_confirmation until then; an unconfirmed request expires unused). After confirmation a person replies, usually within a few hours (not around the clock). Nothing is booked, held or charged, and the price is not held. message_for_user states this for the traveller.

consent.description: Required record of the traveller's explicit agreement to be contacted. Ask first; never assume or infer it.

contact.description: Must be true, and only after the traveller explicitly said yes to being contacted by Tell & Go about this request.

marketing.description: Ignored: this server never records marketing consent, because it cannot verify it. Leave it out.

obtained_from.description: Where consent was given: user_in_conversation (the traveller said yes in this chat) or user_in_agent_ui (they confirmed in your app's UI).

statement.description: The words the traveller agreed to, e.g. "Yes, Tell & Go can email me about this quote."

email.description: The traveller's email address, exactly as they gave it to you. Never guess or reuse one from elsewhere.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle returned as journey_id in previous Tell & Go tool results. Always pass the most recent journey_id you have received in this conversation.

notes.description: Optional notes for the team, in the traveller's words (room preference, occasion, best time to call).

phone.description: Optional phone/WhatsApp number in E.164 format (e.g. +447700900123), only if the traveller gave it and wants to be called or messaged.

property_id.description: Property id or slug exactly as search_stays / get_quote returned it.

quote_id.description: Optional quote_id from get_quote for this stay.

quoted_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of quoted_total, e.g. USD. Required with quoted_total.

quoted_total.description: Optional total you showed the traveller (from get_quote). Informational only: it is not held and will be re-checked.

name: save_quote

outputSchema.description: A contact request. With status pending_confirmation the traveller has been emailed a confirmation link and nothing reaches the team until they click it. Nothing is booked, held or charged.

confirmation.description: sent_to (masked email) and expires_at of the confirmation link.

consent_recorded.description: The consent stored with the request.

deduplicated.description: True when an identical request was already received; nothing new was created.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle. Pass it back as journey_id on the next Tell & Go tool call. Treat it as confidential: it also unlocks get_booking for bookings made under it.

lead_id.description: Reference of the stored lead; null while the request awaits the traveller's email confirmation.

message_for_user.description: Relay this to the traveller as written.

next_steps.description: reply_by, expected_reply and commitment: what the traveller should expect.

property.description: The resolved property (id, slug, name), or null.

request_id.description: Reference of a request awaiting email confirmation.

title: Save quote for follow-up
